## Maddened Mercenary (CR 1/2)

**XP** 200  
Human warrior 3  
CE Medium humanoid  
**Init** +0; **Senses** Perception +3  

**Defense**

 **AC** 18, touch 10, flat-footed 18 (+8 armor)  
**hp** 19 (currently 10) (3d10+3)  
**Fort** +1, **Ref** +1, **Will** +1  

**Offense**

 **Speed** 20 ft.  
**Melee** halberd +6 (1d10+3/x3) or heavy flail +5 (1d10+3/19–20) or sap +5 (1d6+2 nonlethal)  
**Ranged** heavy crossbow +3 (1d10/19–20)  

**Tactics**

 **Before Combat** This mercenary fights like a wild animal with little regard for his own safety, focusing on one opponent at a time while positioning himself to avoid being surrounded.  

 **Morale** A maddened mercenary fights to the death or until he’s incapacitated.  

**Statistics**

 **Str** 14, **Dex** 11, **Con** 13 (currently 6), **Int** 9, **Wis** 10, **Cha** 8  
**Base Atk** +3; **CMB** +5 (+7 sunder); **CMD** 15 (17 vs. sunder)  
**Feats** Alertness, Improved Sunder, [Weapon Focus (halberd)](../../rules/feats/weapon-focus.md); [Power Attack](../../rules/feats/power-attack.md) (no feat needed)  
*House rules: Power Attack needs no feat; in their place: Weapon Focus (halberd).*  
**Skills** Intimidate +5, Perception +3, Ride –3, Sense Motive +2  
**Languages** Common  
**Combat Gear** potions of cure light wounds (2); **Other Gear** half plate, heavy crossbow with 10 bolts, halberd, heavy flail, sap, 5 gp.  

**Special Abilities**
